seo.title: Why Use an Independent Advisor
seo.description: Avoid sales pressure, understand commission before you sign, and save weeks of research — guided by 30+ years of Australian property advice.

data.heading: Confidence before you ever
data.lead: Selling the family home is one of life’s biggest financial decisions. Agent Finder gives you the time, the information and the independent support to make it feel calm — not pressured.

items.title: Save time researching agents
items.body: We do the long‑listing, vetting and reference checks for you.

items.title: Avoid pressure from sales calls
items.body: You stay in control. Agents only contact you when you’re ready.

items.title: Understand commission and marketing
items.body: Plain‑English breakdowns so you can compare like for like.

items.title: Guidance from experienced advisors
items.body: 30+ years of negotiating, listing and selling experience on your side.

items.title: Feel confident before listing
items.body: Go to market with a clear plan, a fair price and an agent you trust.

stamp.text: years of property advisory experience guiding Australian families.
